newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares easier on profit taking.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares easier on profit taking.

text.p: Slovenian shares eased 0.33 percent on Tuesday as profit taking took the steam out of a recent rally.
"Many short-term investors are realising their profits by selling their shares," a trader said.
* The 10-share SBI index fell 3.91 points to 1,188.9.
* Drug maker Lek A issue was again the most actively traded, falling 0.05 percent to 20,000 tolars on volume of 4,829 shares.
* Overall 10 shares fell, four rose, two remained unchanged and eight were untraded.
